gate_digest: SHA-256(be64(19) || "seam-gate-digest:v1" || gate_body), gate_body including its version byte

labels.receipt_jcs: UTF-8 of {"case":"<automate|route>","test":"seam-gate-receipt:test-vector"} (JCS-shaped test bytes, not decision-api's receipt schema)

cases.name: answered_automate_with_certificate
cases.note: decision-api answered automate; the certificate is sealed verbatim

cases.name: answered_route_without_certificate
cases.note: decision-api answered route: certificate_bytes is empty (F("") = be64(0)); a multi-byte UTF-8 flow_id

cases.name: unavailable_token_mint
cases.note: reason 6: the CP-minted Gate token could not be obtained (an outage, EC §16.3)

cases.name: unavailable_max_be64
cases.note: every be64 field is 2^64-1: legal bytes (ranges are policy checks); exceeds JS Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER

presence_states.name: absent
presence_states.note: no Gate for this decision: no 0x05 trailer, field 10 is 0x00

writer_refusals.name: reason_3_written_for_http_404
writer_refusals.note: the body decodes (reason 3 is legal bytes); the rule binds the writer: a 4xx is GATE_REJECTED and is never sealed as unavailable

writer_refusals.name: reason_4_written_for_invalid_receipt
writer_refusals.note: an unverifiable receipt is GATE_INVALID_RESPONSE, never sealed; reason 4 also refuses on decode
